title: 九成CEO推进AI：仅9%看到真转型，回报周期拉长后谁先撑不住？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us right now is the U.S. Chair and CEO of KPMG Tim Walsh. Tim, great to see you here.
segments.zh: 现在加入我们的是毕马威美国主席兼首席执行官蒂姆·沃尔什。蒂姆，很高兴见到你。

segments.en: Great to see you as well, remain. I'm basically talking like 90% of the CEOs out there are basically pushing into AI in some form or another.
segments.zh: 也很高兴见到你，雷曼。我基本上在说，90%的首席执行官都在以某种形式推进人工智能。

segments.en: So they clearly understand the importance of it.
segments.zh: 所以他们显然明白其重要性。

segments.en: There's still a lot of questions as to what the return is on that.
segments.zh: 关于回报是什么，仍有很多问题。

segments.en: I think the number that I saw in your survey was about 9% said, at least as of right now, I've seen some sort of real transformation by it.
segments.zh: 我想我在你的调查中看到的数字是大约9%的人说，至少到目前为止，我已经看到了某种真正的转型。

segments.en: That's a huge gap. Huge gap. But I assume they wouldn't be investing this much if they didn't think that gap was going to narrow.
segments.zh: 这是一个巨大的差距。巨大的差距。但我假设，如果他们不认为这个差距会缩小，他们就不会投入这么多。

segments.en: So so interesting, your intro there just in terms of the blackstone and comments, right?
segments.zh: 所以很有趣，你的开场白就提到了黑石和评论，对吧？

segments.en: Which really lines to the survey results that we're seeing is a result that it's not that CEOs are investing and companies aren't going all in.
segments.zh: 这确实与我们看到的调查结果一致，即不是首席执行官在**而公司没有全力投入。

segments.en: But the time to ROI is definitely, let's say changing or the expectation, right?
segments.zh: 但获得回报的时间肯定在变化，或者说预期在变化，对吧？

segments.en: As we learn more about how to deploy AI into businesses, which is not plug-and-play.
segments.zh: 随着我们更多地了解如何将人工智能部署到业务中，这并不是即插即用的。

segments.en: This requires process redesign AI and data cleanup.
segments.zh: 这需要流程重新设计、AI和数据清理。

segments.en: And then of course for engineering the AI into the businesses. So we feel confident as CEOs that the return will come,
segments.zh: 然后将AI融入业务中。作为CEO，我们相信回报会到来，

segments.en: but there's a required investment in timeline to get there. What are they sort of, are they worried at all about the money that is being spent and whether it is being spent prudently?
segments.zh: 但需要投入和时间才能实现。他们是否担心资金投入以及是否审慎使用？

segments.en: I mean, because when you hear from these people where they come on my show or they're in their surveys, long term, they all seem to be singing from the same him and all.
segments.zh: 因为当这些人上我的节目或参与调查时，长期来看，他们似乎都异口同声。

segments.en: But there was sort of this early stage, I think of this AI and cycle, where there was just a lot of cash being thrown at the wall to see what sticks.
segments.zh: 但在AI周期的早期阶段，大量资金被投入，看看哪些能成功。
